description: Fetch a stable teaser sample of up to 20 public rules (no evidence or remediation). Optionally filter by category. Use when: You have no API key and need to see what a public rule looks like. Avoid when: You have a key and need the full rule. Use fetch_rules or search_rules. Do not claim: A teaser has no remediation. It is not enough to apply the rule. Verify: This is a read. Nothing on the page changes until you edit and scan or lint.
name: fetch_sample_rules
title: Fetch sample rules
